classification: Founder-requested $40000 ask; scenario operating budget, not actual results or approved financing
limitations: All forward user, conversion, churn, cost, ARPU and financing figures are assumptions.
Initial paying users are zero for scenario purposes, not an assertion about production.
Revenue uses average monthly active subscribers, not exit MRR multiplied by 12.
Cash proxy assumes monthly recognized revenue is collected in the same month.
Annual prepayments, deferred revenue, taxes, working capital, debt, depreciation, inflation and refunds are not separately modeled; refunds assumed zero.
B2B, ads and grants are excluded. No guaranteed IELTS/CEFR improvement.
Lean proposed budget. Team names and roles supplied by founder; employment terms and individual compensation have not been supplied.
M01-M06 fixed OPEX 18m UZS/month: founder 8m, engineering/QA contractors 5m, methodology/content 3m, fixed operations 2m. All allocations are proposals.
M07-M12 fixed OPEX 25m, M13-M18 45m, M19-M24 65m, M25-M36 100m UZS/month.
18-month funding coverage depends on modeled subscription collections, not investment alone.
